expansion_contract.fact_row: verified official-source, canonical-state, workflow-evidence or acceptance-contract fact
expansion_contract.boundary_row: prevents publication metadata, data-dictionary fields, availability thresholds or failed download probes from being promoted to exact January 2026 postcode or parcel coverage without accepted r2 bytes and hardened postjoin evidence

source_routes.name: Fixed broadband coverage and full-fibre take-up ZIP endpoint
About this data – fixed coverage and full-fibre take-up (v2)
Canonical slot state and current binary probe

facts.detail: Ofcom published the Spring 2026 Connected Nations update on 13 May 2026.
The report describes fixed broadband availability using a January 2026 snapshot.

guard_streams.write_limit: Publication timing and national snapshot context do not prove coverage for an individual postcode or parcel.

guard_streams.source: Ofcom Connected Nations Spring 2026 download table

facts.detail: The official page lists Fixed_broadband_coverage_and_full_fibre_take-up as the fixed broadband data download.
The official page labels the fixed broadband ZIP as 32.2 MB.

guard_streams.write_limit: A listed download and size are discovery evidence only until the archive bytes are persisted and validated.

guard_streams.source: Ofcom About this data – fixed coverage and full-fibre take-up (v2)

facts.detail: The v2 note states that CW had duplicated CV and MK had duplicated ME, and that both errors were corrected.
The data dictionary records the v2 correction date as 7 July 2026.

guard_streams.write_limit: The correction notice defines acceptance requirements but does not replace validation of the corrected archive.

guard_streams.source: Ofcom About this data – fixed coverage and full-fibre take-up (v2)

facts.detail: The all-premises postcode dataset is documented as 121 postcode-area files.
All 121 all-premises files were renamed from the r1 to the r2 postcode coverage filename pattern.

guard_streams.write_limit: Filename patterns must be matched against the actual ZIP inventory before any join is accepted.

guard_streams.source: Ofcom About this data – fixed coverage and full-fibre take-up (v2)

facts.detail: The January 2026 snapshot received submissions from 52 fixed network and 18 fixed wireless access providers.
Ofcom documents Ordnance Survey AddressBase Premium and Islands Epoch 123 as the premise base for this snapshot.

guard_streams.write_limit: Provider counts and premise-base provenance do not establish a parcel-level service result.

guard_streams.source: Ofcom About this data – fixed coverage and full-fibre take-up (v2)

facts.detail: Ofcom states that the published data is provided under the Open Government Licence, subject to its conditions.
The data dictionary states that the files are CSV and use double-quote text delimiters where applicable.

guard_streams.write_limit: Licence and file-format metadata permit controlled processing but do not validate record contents.

guard_streams.source: Ofcom About this data – fixed coverage and full-fibre take-up (v2)

facts.detail: Ofcom documents 1,741,096 rows across the all-premises postcode files.
The data dictionary lists the all-premises postcode files at 165 MB in total.

guard_streams.write_limit: Documented totals are strict acceptance targets; the observed archive must match before promotion.

guard_streams.source: Ofcom About this data – fixed coverage and full-fibre take-up (v2)

facts.detail: Ofcom documents 1,606,191 rows across 121 residential postcode files.
The residential postcode files retain the documented r1 filename pattern, unlike the corrected all-premises r2 files.

guard_streams.write_limit: Residential files must not be substituted for the required all-premises r2 join.

guard_streams.source: Ofcom About this data – fixed coverage and full-fibre take-up (v2)

facts.detail: The postcode field is documented without spaces, for example SE19HA.
The postcode_space field is documented with one space, for example SE1 9HA.

guard_streams.write_limit: Only exact normalized postcode identity may bind Ofcom area-level coverage to retained canonical rows.

guard_streams.source: Ofcom About this data – fixed coverage and full-fibre take-up (v2)

facts.detail: Ofcom states that full-fibre coverage is not reported at postcode level because of commercial confidentiality.
Gigabit-capable coverage is reported for postcode and output-area files.

guard_streams.write_limit: Do not infer postcode full-fibre availability from gigabit-capable coverage or higher-level full-fibre statistics.

guard_streams.source: Ofcom About this data – fixed coverage and full-fibre take-up (v2)

facts.detail: Coverage figures refer to fixed-line broadband unless a field explicitly identifies fixed wireless access.
FWA evidence is confined to fields whose descriptions explicitly include WISP or mobile FWA.

guard_streams.write_limit: Fixed-line and FWA measures must remain separate and cannot be silently merged into parcel speed claims.

guard_streams.source: Ofcom About this data – fixed coverage and full-fibre take-up (v2)

facts.detail: SFBB availability is defined as coverage at 30 Mbit/s or greater.
The dictionary contains ultrafast availability measures at 100 Mbit/s and 300 Mbit/s thresholds.

guard_streams.write_limit: Coverage-band percentages are area-level availability measures, not measured connection speeds.

guard_streams.source: Ofcom Spring 2026 report and data dictionary

facts.detail: Decent broadband is defined as at least 10 Mbit/s download and 1 Mbit/s upload.
The data dictionary separately identifies premises unable to receive decent broadband from fixed or FWA services.

guard_streams.write_limit: Decent-broadband eligibility or area percentages cannot be converted into an exact parcel throughput measurement.

facts.detail: Ofcom distinguishes fixed broadband coverage files, which describe maximum available speeds, from performance data.
The FAQ states that Ofcom has not published a fixed performance postcode file since the July 2024 methodology revision.

guard_streams.write_limit: Availability must not be labelled as observed performance, and no postcode performance value may be invented.

facts.detail: The current environment could not resolve the Ofcom host for binary transfer, so no ZIP bytes were persisted.
No live owner or stale pending execution exists; the same task and continuation key remain, with zero candidate or accuracy promotions.

guard_streams.write_limit: Keep the manual host action open and do not start a duplicate runner or promote candidates without archive, join and postjoin PASS evidence.
